title: Run Attack Narrative Foundation
goal: Generate an operator-reviewed attack narrative for completed runs from existing evidence, findings, chains, and attack paths.
scope: Add an optional RunAiNarrative-style report layer that synthesizes reconnaissance, attack paths, critical findings, and remediation priority from stored run data. The narrative must be clearly marked as AI-assisted or generated advisory text, editable/reviewable by the operator, and separate from canonical evidence and report facts.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md calls for coherent attack narratives beyond list-style reports, while existing report drafting remains a first slice.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Narrative generation only. Do not replace canonical reports, mutate findings, change methodology mappings, or make unreviewed customer claims.

success_criteria: Completed runs can expose an optional narrative grounded in stored findings, inventory, attack paths, chain detections, and evidence references.
Narrative sections are clearly marked as AI-assisted or advisory and require operator review.
Normal markdown/HTML/PDF exports remain available without an AI provider.
Sparse run data produces truthful unavailable or limited narrative output.
Tests cover narrative generation, fallback, sparse data, and no canonical data mutation.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Attack narratives are evidence-grounded and operator-reviewed.
Canonical report facts and findings remain unchanged.
Provider-disabled/failure behavior leaves normal reports intact.

before_promotion: Contextual remediation and exploitability intelligence foundation is completed and logged.
Narrative section structure and review wording are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with attack-narrative changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the reviewed narrative baseline and remaining report limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
